name: companies
description: One workflow across two company boundaries. Our quay office files every arrival (an effect of ours, kept whatever happens next) and engages the pilot office: the hire is our own procedure, placed by the peers file onto their engine, there committed - an effect outside our walls, and their whole team answers as one wrapper (triage, the chart room on a third engine, the boarding call). Kit decides on our desk, and the partners never see that page. A partner that goes dark after the hire started is unknown: may or may not have happened, never guessed, never retried. The house rules never name a company; the peers side file does.

neurons.description: A vessel arrives, needing exceptions cleared.
Our intake desk: sorts the arrival, hands it on.
Files the arrival in our own ledger. An effect of ours, kept whatever happens next.

The hire: our own procedure, placed by the peers file onto the pilot office's engine, there committed. An effect: started once, never guessed, never retried; if the office goes dark after it started, the outcome is unknown.

The pilot office as one wrapper: their whole team is behind it - triage, the chart room (a third engine), the boarding call. Their answer carries every mark back to our desk, and becomes our harbourmaster's ask.
Kit, our harbourmaster: clear the arrival with the pilot office, or hold. On our desk; the partners never see this page.
Carries out the clearance. An effect.
